import re,sys
s=open('Apps/ParticleUniverse/App/DeviceConditionsSource.swift').read()
reads=[m.start() for m in re.finditer(r'forKey: "uitest', s)]
blocks=[(m.start(), s.index('#endif', m.start())) for m in re.finditer(r'#if DEBUG', s)]
out=[r for r in reads if not any(a<r<b for a,b in blocks)]
print('uitest UserDefaults reads', len(reads), 'outside DEBUG', len(out)); sys.exit(1 if out else 0)
